program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (cell-color p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
             (define (put gg r c v) (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
             (define comps
               (filter (lambda (o)
                         (let ((vals (map cell-color (obj-cells o))))
                           (and (member 4 vals) (for/or ((v vals)) (!= v 4)))))
                       (objects-multicolor g 0)))
             (define (avg-round xs)
               (let ((n (length xs)) (s (apply + xs))) (quotient (+ (* 2 s) n) (* 2 n))))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((comp comps))
               (define cells (obj-cells comp))
               (define fours (filter (lambda (p) (= (cell-color p) 4)) cells))
               (define payload (filter (lambda (p) (!= (cell-color p) 4)) cells))
               (define main-color (mode-list (map cell-color payload)))
               (define frs (map first fours))
               (define fcs (map second fours))
               (define span-r (- (max-list frs) (min-list frs)))
               (define span-c (- (max-list fcs) (min-list fcs)))
               (define cleared (paint-cells out payload 0))
               (if (> span-c span-r)
                   (let* ((axis (avg-round frs))
                          (above (count-if (lambda (p)
                                             (and
                                               (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                               (< (first p) axis)))
                                           payload))
                          (below (count-if (lambda (p)
                                             (and
                                               (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                               (> (first p) axis)))
                                           payload))
                          (choose-above (>= above below))
                          (source (filter (lambda (p)
                                            (or
                                              (= (first p) axis)
                                              (if choose-above
                                                  (< (first p) axis)
                                                  (> (first p) axis))))
                                          cells)))
                     (for/fold ((gg cleared))
                       ((p source))
                       (define r (first p))
                       (define c (second p))
                       (define rr (- (* 2 axis) r))
                       (define v (cell-color p))
                       (put (put gg r c v) rr c v)))
                   (let* ((axis (avg-round fcs))
                          (left (count-if (lambda (p)
                                            (and
                                              (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                              (< (second p) axis)))
                                          payload))
                          (right (count-if (lambda (p)
                                             (and
                                               (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                               (> (second p) axis)))
                                           payload))
                          (choose-left (>= left right))
                          (source (filter (lambda (p)
                                            (or
                                              (= (second p) axis)
                                              (if choose-left
                                                  (< (second p) axis)
                                                  (> (second p) axis))))
                                          cells)))
                     (for/fold ((gg cleared))
                       ((p source))
                       (define r (first p))
                       (define c (second p))
                       (define cc (- (* 2 axis) c))
                       (define v (cell-color p))
                       (put (put gg r c v) r cc v)))))))))
